visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Transform written with the wrong function
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The box should be flipped upside down, but nothing happens. The transform uses a function name that does not exist.
visualizerParams.buggyCode: Up

solution.code: Up
solution.explanation: CSS ignores a declaration with an unknown function, so the box is not transformed and there is no error. The function for turning is rotate.
